cards.text: Judah's King Ahaziah is dead. His mother, Athaliah, sees that her son is gone. And friend, what she does next is NOT a sympathy card.

cards.question: Athaliah sees that her son Ahaziah is dead. What does she set out to do?

answers.text: Hand the throne to a grandson

cards.text: But one woman makes a move. Jehoshabeath, King Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's sister, steals Ahaziah's son Joash right out from among the king's sons who are being murdered.

cards.question: Jehoshabeath tucks little Joash and his ___ away in a bedroom.

cards.text: Here's the kicker: Jehoshabeath is the wife of Jehoiada the priest. And she hides Joash from Athaliah so Athaliah can't kill him.

cards.question: Jehoshabeath is married to Jehoiada the priest. So where does Joash stay hidden with them?
Joash stays hidden in the house of God for ___ years while Athaliah rules the land.

cards.text: SIX years in hiding. Friend, I did years in a junk drawer, and nobody was even LOOKING for me.

cards.question: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthens himself and makes a covenant with five men. Who are they?
The commanders go all through Judah and gather the ___ from every city, along with the heads of Israel's families.

cards.text: Everybody comes to Jerusalem, and the whole assembly makes a covenant with the king in the house of God. Then Jehoiada makes the big reveal: “Behold, the king’s son!”

cards.question: Jehoiada says the king's son must reign. Why?

answers.text: The LORD promised it to David's line
The army has already chosen him
Athaliah once named him her heir

cards.question: Jehoiada splits the priests and Levites coming on duty that Sabbath into thirds, and one third stands guard at the royal palace.
During the plan, Jehoiada lets all the people into the house of the LORD.

cards.text: The Levites must surround the king with weapons in hand and stay close to him wherever he goes. Friend, in the drawer my whole security team was ONE rubber band.

cards.question: Everyone follows Jehoiada's orders, and he sends the divisions going off duty home.
From the house of God, Jehoiada hands the commanders spears and shields that belonged to King ___.

cards.text: He stations the troops all around the king, by the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north. Then Jehoiada and his sons bring out the king's son.

cards.question: Jehoiada and his sons bring out the king's son. What do they put on him?

cards.text: They present him with the Testimony, proclaim him king, anoint him and shout, “Long live the king!” From a hidden bedroom to a CROWN, friend, and I thought MY comeback from the drawer was something.
Athaliah hears the noise of the people running and cheering the king. So she goes out to them in the house of the LORD.

She looks, and there's the king standing by his pillar at the entrance, with officers, trumpets, singers leading the praises and the whole land rejoicing. Six years running the place, and NOBODY told her about the party.

cards.question: Athaliah sees the new king and the whole crowd celebrating. What does she do?

answers.text: Bows down before the new king

cards.text: She screams, “Treason, treason!” Then Jehoiada sends out the commanders: “Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.”

cards.question: Jehoiada wants Athaliah put to death right there in the house of the LORD.

cards.text: They seize Athaliah as she reaches the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.

cards.question: Jehoiada makes a covenant between himself, the king and the people. What do they agree to be?
After the covenant, the people leave the temple of Baal standing.

cards.text: They tear it down, smash the altars and idols to pieces, and kill Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.

cards.question: Jehoiada puts someone in charge of the house of the LORD. Who?

cards.text: These are the priests David appointed, and they offer burnt offerings to the LORD as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and song. Back on schedule, friend. Ovens ON.

cards.question: Jehoiada leaves the gates of the house of the LORD open to anyone at all.

cards.text: Then Jehoiada takes the commanders, the nobles, the rulers and all the people of the land, and they bring the king down from the house of the LORD and into the royal palace through the Upper Gate.

cards.question: Inside the palace, they seat King Joash on the royal ___.
All the people of the land rejoice, and the city is ___.

cards.text: The city is quiet because Athaliah has been put to the sword. But hang on, friend, because Joash's story is just getting started.

findings.problem: This story card tells no new part of the passage. It repeats the answer the baker just gave on card 7 (six years in hiding) and adds a joke. Its only verse, 2 Chronicles 22:12, is already fully covered by cards 6 and 7. Move the joke onto a card that tells the next piece of the passage, or cut the card.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage.

findings.problem: About half of this stop's choice cards are discovery questions that only luck can answer: card 4 (nurse), card 7 (six years), card 9 (commanders of hundreds), card 10 (Levites), card 13 (a third at the royal palace) and card 16 (no divisions released). Cards 9 and 10 come straight after a joke card with no setup at all, so the baker has nothing to reason from. Add context on story cards before these questions, or ask about something the baker can reason out.

rule.text: A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

findings.problem: Which third of the guard stands at the royal palace, rather than at the doors or the Foundation Gate, is a placement detail. It doesn't move the passage forward, and the baker doesn't need it to understand the passage. It's also a pure guess, because no card has told any part of the guard plan yet. Ask about the point of the plan instead, like guarding the king, or tell the placements on a story card.

rule.text: Ask about the moments that move the passage forward and the details the baker needs to understand it.

findings.problem: "Back on schedule, friend. Ovens ON." blends the bakery image with the burnt offerings in the Bible setting. It also implies that the temple worship had stopped and was being restarted, which 2 Chronicles 23:18 doesn't say.

rule.text: One image only. Never blend the comparison with the Bible setting.

findings.problem: Choice cards 2, 4, 6, 7 and 9 strictly alternate multiple choice and fill in the blank (MC, FB, MC, FB, MC).

rule.text: Which question type comes next, the order the types come in and where a blank falls are chosen naturally for each card. They never follow a pattern.

findings.problem: Choice cards 3, 5, 7, 8, 10 and 12 strictly alternate multiple choice and true or false (MC, TF, MC, TF, MC, TF).

rule.text: Which question type comes next, the order the types come in and where a blank falls are chosen naturally for each card. They never follow a pattern.
